limitations: Verifies one idealized planar case in software; it is not calibration or field validation.
max_z is set far above the reachable energy-line height so the clip is not exercised.
Lateral spreading is not graded; only the straight downslope release column is compared.
purpose: Verify that the offline com4FlowPy adapter reproduces the closed-form Flow-Py energy-line solution on a planar slope, and that its stopping cell matches the analytical angle-of-reach intersection exactly.
threshold_basis: The analytical solution is exact, so the only admissible error is float32 raster round-off. The limits are set two orders of magnitude above the observed round-off and were fixed before the graded run.

upstream_reference.citation: Neuhauser, D'Amboise, Teich, Kofler, Huber, Fromm, Fischer (2022), Geosci. Model Dev. 15, 2423-2442
upstream_reference.routing_rule: z_delta(next) = z_delta(current) + dz - ds*tan(alpha), clipped to [0, max_z]
